name: SELENE dust occlusion view

original_specification.name: SELENE dust occlusion view
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for arm and vial partly occluded by visible dust particles.
use_cases: Arm and vial partly occluded by visible dust particles
original_specification.sources: Existing environment sun or declared onboard light
original_specification.geometry: Dust is real geometry or a separately justified local medium, never global atmospheric haze
original_specification.contribution_policy: Rig contributes only identified source energy
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Do not add atmospheric scattering to a vacuum scene by default

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
